# Retail canonical data dictionary

`retail_facility_month` — **546 columns**, one row per retail customer's ONE facility at ONE month-end.

> **Synthetic Saudi retail demonstration data — not ANB customer data or approved models.** Every threshold, coefficient, bin boundary and distribution in this document is a demonstration assumption. None of it is an ANB policy, a SAMA requirement or a validated model.

*Generated by `scripts/write_retail_docs.py` from the registries the running product reads. Do not edit by hand — edit the code and regenerate.*


## How to read the aggregation column

| Semantics | What it means | How it aggregates |
|---|---|---|
| STOCK | A level at a point in time | Sum within ONE snapshot. Never across months. |
| FLOW | An amount for a period | Sum across the months of the period wanted. |
| RATIO | A quotient | Recompute from summed numerator over summed denominator. Never average a ratio. |
| COUNT | An occurrence count over a window | Read the window in the name. |
| DESCRIPTOR | A label | Count, do not sum. |
| IDENTIFIER | A key | Count distinct. |
| EVENT_DATE | When something happened | Not summable. |
| EVALUATION_LABEL | Forward-looking outcome knowledge | Evaluation only. Never a predictor. |

A column whose grain is CUSTOMER is repeated on each of that customer's facilities. Summing it over facility rows counts one person's income, or one person's obligations, several times over.

| `score_input_stale_count` | Score input stale count | integer | — | FACILITY | all | none | Model inputs that were present but older than their freshness rule allows. Stale is not missing, and the two are counted apart. |
